bab.ringkasan: Social function & struktur goal-materials-steps, language features (imperative, sequence connectors/adverbs), pola soal urutan/troubleshooting/reference/kategorisasi — dengan susun urutan manual, jodohkan fitur bahasa, benar/salah, isian rumpang, CG-PROCEDURE, dan 25 soal resmi bank (robot vacuum, tips keuangan, literasi anak, setup Nest Hub, tips belajar bahasa) + pembahasan dua jalur.

sections.teks: Procedure Text: How to Make, Do, and Operate

Procedure text tells HOW to make/do/use/operate something through a sequence of steps. Social function: memberi panduan langkah demi langkah agar tujuan tercapai — dari resep sampai manual robot vacuum.

Soal procedure di TKA jarang tentang hafalan — ia menguji logika urutan: what comes next, what if a step is skipped, what does "it/then" refer to, dan kategorisasi problem-solution atau passive-active. Kuasai penanda urutan dan kalimat imperatif, semuanya terpeta.
Procedure adalah resep masakan: judul = goal, bahan = materials, cara memasak = steps. Satu langkah terbalik saja, kue gagal — begitu juga soal "what should be checked first".

items: Materials — bahan/alat/peralatan yang dibutuhkan (tidak selalu ada).

rows.v: Press the button; Plug in the dock; Don't skip this step.
once it is worn out, before using, while charging.
The light turns green when fully charged.

sections.judul: 🧩 Susun: langkah memasang & menguji robot vacuum (adaptasi teks 1)
sections.keterangan: Urutkan seperti manual: pemasangan dulu, lalu pemetaan.
items: Install the side brush until it clicks
Place the charging dock against a wall and plug it in
Put the robot on the dock until the light turns green
Run the first mapping session so the robot learns the layout

items.kiri: Press and hold for three seconds

items.teks: The goal of a procedure text is usually expressed in the title ("How to ...").
Steps may be presented in any order as long as all are included.
items.penjelasan: Urutan adalah inti procedure; terbalik = gagal.

items.teks: Imperative sentences are the typical mood of procedure steps.
Materials section is mandatory in every procedure text.
items.penjelasan: Tips/kiat (seperti teks keuangan) bisa tanpa materials.

sections.teks: Buat garis langkah 1..n di kertas buram saat membaca; semua soal urutan/reference/troubleshooting dijawab dari garis itu.
items: Nomori langkah saat membaca pertama kali (1,2,3...).
Soal "right after X" = lihat langkah n+1 di garismu.
Soal "if X fails/skipped" = cari konsekuensi di kalimat peringatan langkah itu atau langkah berikutnya.
Reference it/them/both = benda/perangkat terdekat sebelumnya yang cocok secara logika.

sections.teks: Pengecoh favorit: menukar urutan dua langkah yang "keduanya masuk akal" (pasang sikat vs letakkan dock). Kembali ke konektor teks (first/then/after that), bukan logika rumah tangga.

items.soal: The section that lists the tools or ingredients needed is called ...
opsi: goal
materials
steps
re-orientation
identification
items.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: materials = bahan/alat (bank h.88). Jalur Cara Gemilang: struktur G-M-S.

items.soal: Read the steps! (1) Plug in the kettle. (2) Fill it with water to the max line. (3) Close the lid. (4) Press the switch. Which order is correct according to safe procedure?
items.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: isi air dulu sebelum listrik (aman), tutup, baru nyalakan; menancapkan colokan setelah terisi menghindari pemanasan kosong. Jalur Cara Gemilang: garis langkah + logika keselamatan.

items.soal: "Change the filter once it is worn out." The phrase "once it is worn out" functions as ...
opsi: a sequence adverb of condition/time
a goal
an imperative
a material
a conclusion
items.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: penanda waktu/syarat urutan = sequence adverb. Jalur Cara Gemilang: CG-PROCEDURE — penanda urutan bukan langkah.

rows.v: "If X fails, what to check first?"

rows.w: To tell/how to guide — panduan langkah.

items.teks: The title section "How to ..." expresses the ... of a procedure text.
Connectors like "then" and "after that" are called ... connectors.
Sentences that give commands directly to the reader are ... sentences.

sections.teks: Ambil manual benda di rumahmu (setrika, router, rice cooker), tulis ulang sebagai procedure 4 langkah berbahasa Inggris dengan satu sequence adverb dan satu kalimat peringatan — lalu tukar dengan teman untuk diuji soal "what if".

25 soal resmi bab ini memakai 5 procedure: manual robot vacuum, tips keuangan pribadi, literasi keuangan anak, setup Google Nest Hub, dan tips belajar bahasa lewat film. Garis langkahmu adalah senjatanya.

Read the following text carefully!

An Intelligent Robotic Vacuum Cleaner, EcoClin Vacuum, is equipped with both Wet and Dry-Cleaning Feature allowing Mopping and Vacuuming all-in-one-go.

How to install the robot?

Note: While connecting to the application, make sure your Wi-Fi is in 2.4G connection. If not, you can ask your service provider to enable 2.4G connection.

(adapted from https://ecovacsindia.in/index)

Which statements are supported by the information in the text? There is more than one correct answer. Choose all correct answers!
opsi: The installation service is available to customers who have purchased the device.
The robot must be placed on the base for charging before operation.
Too many obstacles can cause inefficient and faulty map directions.
All components must be removed from the packaging before installation.
The EcoClin Vacuum can only connect to a 5G Wi-Fi network.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: Pernyataan mana yang didukung oleh informasi dalam teks adalah: The robot must be placed on the base for charging before operation (Robot harus ditempatkan di base untuk pengisian sebelum digunakan.) Too many obstacles can cause inefficient and faulty map directions (Terlalu banyak hambatan dapat menyebabkan pemetaan yang tidak efisien dan salah.) All components must be removed from the packaging before installation (Semua komponen harus dikeluarkan dari kemasan sebelum instalasi.) Jalur Cara Gemilang: Supported statements = cocokkan per pernyataan ke langkah manual; yang menambah aturan baru = salah.

If a user skips linking their streaming accounts during setup, how might that impact their use of the device? There is more than one correct answer. Choose all correct answers!
opsi: The device will remain unusable because the app is required to configure it.
They would not be able to easily access personalized music or video content.
Their device will not turn on or may not function properly.
The device will not recognize individual users, which means no personalized responses.

ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: Dampak yang akan terjadi jika pengguna melewatkan langkah menghubungkan akun streaming saat setup adalah: They would not be able to easily access personalized music or video content (Mereka tidak dapat dengan mudah mengakses konten musik atau video yang dipersonalisasi) They won't be able to use music/video services or make calls (Mereka tidak dapat menggunakan layanan musik/video atau melakukan panggilan) Jika pengguna tidak menghubungkan akun streaming saat proses setup, maka mereka tidak dapat mengakses konten musik atau video secara personal serta tidak dapat menggunakan layanan streaming maupun fitur panggilan. Namun, perangkat tetap dapat digunakan untuk fungsi dasar lainnya. Jalur Cara Gemilang: Dampak melewatkan langkah = fungsi yang tak jalan (streaming & personalisasi).

What is the purpose of looking up new words while watching films or series mentioned in the tips?
opsi: To apply what has been learned in real-life communication, which helps to develop fluency and confidence
To help learners move from understanding the language to actively using it effectively
To understand the meaning of unfamiliar words and phrases so the viewer can better follow the content and learn new vocabulary
To strengthen memory and retention so new vocabulary can be remembered and reviewed later

(taken from https://www.europelanguagejobs.com)

Which step from the tips focuses most on improving speaking ability? There is more than one correct answer. Choose all correct answers!
opsi: Checking meanings using a dictionary, app, or subtitles
Writing down new words, phrases, or expressions learned
Saying sentences from the film or series out loud, especially difficult ones
Using applications to find language exchange partners, or hiring a tutor
Using the new words and expressions in real-life conversations or daily situations
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Jalur konsep: Langkah yang paling fokus meningkatkan kemampuan berbicara adalah: Saying sentences from the film or series out loud, especially difficult ones (Mengucapkan kalimat-kalimat dari film atau serial dengan lantang, terutama yang sulit). Using the new words and expressions in real-life conversations or daily situations (Menggunakan kata-kata dan ungkapan baru dalam percakapan kehidupan nyata atau situasi sehari-hari). Langkah yang paling meningkatkan kemampuan berbicara adalah mengucapkan kalimat secara langsung dan menggunakan bahasa tersebut dalam percakapan sehari-hari karena keduanya melatih pengucapan dan kelancaran berbicara. Jalur Cara Gemilang: Tips speaking = mengucapkan kalimat keras-keras + memakai dalam percakapan.
